title: Average purchase
statementMd:
Average purchase size (positive) per merchant, rounded to 2 decimals, for merchants with at least 10 purchases.

Expected columns: `merchant`, `avg_purchase`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT merchant, ROUND(-AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_purchase FROM transactions WHERE kind = 'purchase' GROUP BY merchant HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
